# Watercolor

Paints the image in watercolor: soft washes that bleed and waver, darker rims where pigment pools, and grain where it settles into the paper.

<EffectDemo effect="watercolor" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { watercolor } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/watercolor';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(watercolor({ preset: 'wet' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.bleed = 4`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter       | Type                                                          | Default     | Range     | Description                                                             |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bleed`         | number                                                        | `4`         | 0 – 16 px | How far colors bleed into each other.                                   |
| `wobble`        | number                                                        | `4`         | 0 – 16 px | How much edges waver.                                                   |
| `edgeDarkening` | number                                                        | `0.7`       | 0 – 1     | Darker rims where the wash changes.                                     |
| `granulation`   | number                                                        | `0.6`       | 0 – 1     | Pigment settling into the paper grain.                                  |
| `paper`         | hex color (theme: [`background`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#fbf7ee'` |           | Paper color, which shows through thin washes.                           |
| `seed`          | integer                                                       | `0`         | 0 – 9999  | Picks the random pattern: the same seed always renders the same frames. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                       |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `wet`        | `bleed: 10`, `wobble: 6`, `edgeDarkening: 0.9` |
| `dry`        | `bleed: 2`, `granulation: 1`                   |
| `sketchbook` | `paper: '#f1e8d6'`, `wobble: 8`                |
| `gentle`     | `edgeDarkening: 0.3`, `granulation: 0.3`       |

Apply one with `watercolor({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Stylization · tracked as story X8.9 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 114.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 8.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/watercolor`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: After Bousseau et al., Interactive watercolor rendering with temporal coherence and abstraction, 2006: wobble, edge darkening and pigment granulation.

## Related

- [Kuwahara (painterly)](./kuwahara) — An edge-preserving smoothing filter that turns detail into flat, brushy patches, like an oil painting: each pixel takes the calmest neighboring region’s average.
- [Pencil sketch](./pencil) — Redraws the scene as a pencil sketch on paper: contours from the geometry (depth and normals) and the image, and shading in diagonal strokes that pile up in the shadows.
- [Toon posterize](./posterize) — Flattens brightness into a few bands while keeping each color’s hue, and darkens edges, for a cartoon look on any image.
